data.title: Tom Lee’s BitMine Owns 4.9% of All Ethereum. What Happens When It Hits 5%?
data.description: Tom Lee's BitMine is weeks away from controlling 5% of all Ethereum in circulation, and what the company does after crossing that threshold could reshape demand for the entire network.
